rows.definition: The 64-byte AMD AQL kernel dispatch packet structure matching the HSA ABI hsa_kernel_dispatch_packet_t layout, used to launch a compute kernel on AMD GPUs.
rows.distinction: The packet payload structure itself; it is not the packet-type tag AQLPacketTypeKernelDispatch that classifies its header, nor the doorbell path that submits it.

rows.definition: The AQL packet-type constant (value 2) marking a standard compute kernel dispatch in the AMD AQL/HSA ABI.
rows.distinction: A header classification tag on AQL packets; it is not the 64-byte dispatch packet structure AQLKernelDispatchPacket it labels.

rows.definition: The conceptbench ArmKind value ('gateway') that registers the internal/gateway transport as a frontier-tier benchmark arm.
rows.distinction: A benchmark arm registration in conceptbench; it is not a runtime gateway instance, a gateway URL, or the gateway package itself.

rows.definition: The execution-identity field naming which engine (fak-native or llama.cpp) a Qwen3.8 quant-run campaign trial was executed on.
rows.distinction: A per-trial identity assertion checked by ValidateFakNativeRequestIdentity; it is not the ExecutionEngine campaign-evidence type nor the registered engine directory.

rows.definition: The tb4bench interface abstracting the container daemon (Docker or Podman) that runs sandboxed task workspaces.
rows.distinction: The daemon abstraction interface; it is not the concrete DockerEngine implementation that talks to the Docker/Podman socket.

rows.definition: The process-wide bool set once at init when FAK_CUDA_TIMESTAMP_PROFILE=1, enabling CUDA kernel timestamp profiling and gating graph-once capture.
rows.distinction: A CUDA profiling toggle inside the compute shim; it is not an in-kernel radix/KVMMU environment knob nor a reported metric.

rows.definition: The default list of verified physical Vulkan compute subkernel selectors that a Strix receipt credits when no explicit CreditSubkernelSelectors override is given.
rows.distinction: The default selector roster for receipt crediting; it is not a single subkernel, the kernel registry, or the receipt verification path that consumes it.

rows.definition: The tb4bench container-daemon client that communicates with the Docker/Podman daemon over a Unix domain socket or Windows named pipe.
rows.distinction: The concrete Docker/Podman daemon client; it is not the generic ContainerEngine interface it implements.

rows.definition: The receipt provenance field naming the model execution engine (for example 'fak-native/vulkan') stamped on Strix and nativeperfcorrelation receipts.
rows.distinction: A provenance stamp on a completed receipt; it is not the live engine registry entry EngineID nor the webbench EngineReceiptDigest digest.

rows.definition: The SubagentFanoutEngine method resolving the authoritative engine name from available receipt fields for acceptance validation.
rows.distinction: A name-resolution accessor on fanout receipts; it is not the engine registry id EngineID nor the provenance EngineModel.

rows.definition: The internal/enginestep package observing the native continuous-batching cycle step-by-step and emitting the fak_engine_* metric families.
rows.distinction: The step-observation package and its process-wide Default observer; it is not the 'engine' dispatch seam, the engines registry, or any single fak_engine_* series.

rows.definition: The fail-closed error returned when a routed expert's device kernel is absent, forcing the memory-bound scalar loop instead of the fused device path.
rows.distinction: An error sentinel pinned by errors.Is in the fp8_block32 expert path; it is not the OOM/capacity error family nor the expert-spill seam.

rows.definition: The Prometheus metric family prefix (fak_engine_*) reporting the native continuous-batching cycle step-by-step, per request and process-wide.
rows.distinction: The family prefix rendered by enginestep and the gateway observation endpoints; it is not any single fak_engine_* series such as the planner-step or kernel subfamilies.

rows.definition: The gateway Prometheus counter family prefix (fak_gateway_inference_*) covering inference throughput counters such as output tokens per second.
rows.distinction: The inference counter family prefix; it is not the KV-prefix reuse family (fak_gateway_kv_prefix_*), the scope-refusal counter, or a single series like fak_gateway_inference_output_tokens_per_second.

rows.definition: The gateway counter of prompt tokens served from the KV prefix cache, exposed in the KV-prefix reuse metric family.
rows.distinction: A prompt-token total; it is not the by-source breakdown fak_gateway_kv_prefix_prompt_tokens_by_source_total nor the turn counters of the same family.

rows.definition: The gateway counter of KV-prefix turns labeled by serving-latency regime (for example frozen), cut for the #5630 regime analysis.
rows.distinction: The regime-labeled turn counter; it is not the unlabeled turn total fak_gateway_kv_prefix_turns_total nor the prompt-token counter.

rows.definition: The gateway counter of turns observed through the KV prefix cache, equal to cacheobs.Default.Snapshot().Turns.
rows.distinction: The unlabeled turn total; it is not the regime-labeled variant fak_gateway_kv_prefix_turns_by_regime_total nor the prompt-token total.

rows.definition: The gateway counter of scope-guard route-class refusals, labeled by the closed scope/route_class label set.
rows.distinction: A scope-admission refusal observation; it is not an HTTP 502 status, a readiness bit, or the KV-prefix reuse counters.

rows.definition: The Qwen3.8 MTP receipt field naming the target-decode engine used when the MTP speculative path falls back, from a closed fak-native vocabulary.
rows.distinction: A receipt field recording which engine actually served after fallback; it is not the primary Engine field, the NativeEngine descriptor, or an engine registry entry.

rows.definition: The pkg/gatewayauth package providing the gateway health key-possession proof wire (KeyProofPath, ServeKeyProof, WriteHealthProof).
rows.distinction: The key-possession proof wire package; it is not the FAK_GATEWAY_KEY credential environment variable, the GatewayKey HIL field, or the gateway server itself.

rows.definition: The Strix HIL/installer field carrying the gateway bearer key for guarded router launches, resolved via resolveGatewayKey.
rows.distinction: A receipt/installer credential field; it is not the FAK_GATEWAY_KEY environment variable name, the key-proof wire package, or the default gateway bearer token.

rows.definition: The upstream ferrite CUDA kernel implementing the WYF chunkwise parallel GatedDeltaNet recurrence, cited in the GLM5.3 concept study as a DIRECT-PORT target for internal/compute.
rows.distinction: An upstream reference kernel name from the ferrite project; it is not a fak-owned compute kernel selector, the qwen3.5 GDN kernel-error path, or the coordinator kernel.

rows.definition: The measured GPU-engine active-time delta in nanoseconds captured by the llamacppinterop Strix comparator authority as part of its resource evidence.
rows.distinction: A comparator resource-evidence field; it is not a Prometheus gauge, the host-overhead InterKernelGapSumUs decomposition, or a kernel counter.

rows.definition: The closed phase/bucket label ('gpu_kernel') marking raw GPU kernel execution and tensor GEMM time in time-burndown buckets and native-perf trace phases.
rows.distinction: An observation-phase label for wall-time accounting; it is not a compute kernel selector (q4Kernel/q8Kernel/backendKernel) nor the kernel coordinator.

rows.definition: The model.Config predicate reporting whether PrefixSnapshot owns every in-kernel backend's prefix state, making in-kernel prefix reuse fail-closed supported.
rows.distinction: The all-backends predicate; it is not the per-backend variant InKernelBackendPrefixReuseSupportedFor, nor the shared system/tools boundary hint.

rows.definition: The model.Config predicate reporting whether PrefixSnapshot owns the prefix state of one specific in-kernel backend, the qualified check used by warm-route decisions.
rows.distinction: The per-backend qualified predicate; it is not the all-backends InKernelBackendPrefixReuseSupported, nor the shared boundary hint from context.

rows.definition: The internal/agent/inkernel_decode.go source file implementing the in-kernel decode lane (snapshot checkpoint, PrimeCacheState, generated-continuation steps).
rows.distinction: A source-file seam referenced by comments and the godfile ceiling baseline; it is not the inkernel engine id, the expert-spill seam file, or the decode V41 lane helpers.

rows.definition: The agent predicate deciding whether to suppress Qwen thinking-mode rendering (enable_thinking=false) for an in-kernel request based on config and span.
rows.distinction: A render-time thinking-suppression predicate; it is not the Qwen Q4_K prefill chunk setting, the FAK_INKERNEL_BATCH knob, or the jinja template variables themselves.

rows.definition: The closed tool-routing provenance value ('kernel_decide') marking calls adjudicated through the fak kernel without execution.
rows.distinction: A provenance label on routing records; it is not the fak_kernel_decisions_total counter, the KernelCheck preflight, or the kernel coordinator itself.
